findings.highlight: If I stop eating from now on
findings.evidenceJa: 彼に、今から食事を断たれてしまったら
findings.governingReading: Saber imagines Shirou cutting off her meals from now on, which would sap her will to fight.
findings.explanation: The English makes Saber choose to stop eating, reversing the actor and breaking the mock siege logic of dependence on Shirou’s provisions.
